analysis.purpose: The test suite for framework — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: frameworkSemantics — class scope (member-of aggregation); frameworkSemantics — method scope (direct; lean vs full); frameworkSemantics — unresolved honesty; buildDossier wiring — lean framework + shapeVersion.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of framework
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
